name: Dubbing Desk
description: A presenter clip taken through four steps: transcribe it, translate the script into the language you pick, voice and subtitle the translation, then lip-sync the footage. You can edit the script and the translation before anything is voiced, so the words that get dubbed are the words you see.

props.text: One presenter clip, spoken in another language, voiced, subtitled and lip-synced.
Transcription, translation, speech, and lip-sync use configured models and are billed per run.

props.subtitle: Add a clip of one person who talks to the camera. The app writes down what they say.
Pick the language of the dub and a language model. The same model writes the subtitles later. Read the translation and fix it before it is voiced.
Speak the translation with a new voice and break it into subtitle lines. The lip-sync uses this voice track.
Redraw the mouth so the presenter speaks the voice track from the last step. Lip-sync is billed per second of footage.

workflows.name: Transcribe a Clip
workflows.description: Pull the spoken words out of a video. Audio is extracted locally, then transcribed. Note the provider choice: fal and Replicate both list speech-to-text models in their manifests, but neither provider implements the transcription capability, so those entries cannot execute. OpenAI, Gemini, HuggingFace, MiniMax and Together do implement it.

workflows.description: A spoken script translated into the language you name, kept close to the original length so the new voice track fits the same footage.

data.system: You translate scripts for dubbing. Write what a presenter would naturally say in the target language, not a literal translation. Keep each sentence close to the length of the original so the new voice fits the same timing. Return only the translated script, with no notes, no headings and none of the source text.

workflows.name: Narrate a Script
workflows.description: Turn written copy into a voice track with ElevenLabs multilingual v2 on fal. Pair it with Score a Silent Clip to build a narrated cut from text alone. Billed per character.
